none: PAS NLM-7A79F8: Roman Coin: Nummus of House of Constantine from Preston
contea di ritrovamento: East Riding of Yorkshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Copper alloy. Coin. Nummus, probably of House of Constantine (306-361), possibly Caesarum Nostrorum issue of 321-324. Encrusted obverse. Obverse description: Bust possibly diademed right. Obverse inscription: [--]TIV[--]. Reverse description: Wreath enclosing (illegible) vow. Reverse inscription: Possibly [CAESARVM NOSTRORVM]. Cliff Reeves kindly examined this coin.
